answer: Let a zephyr beacon gust assign one live task per agent at an unpredictable moment, needing a specific reply inside a short window: running n clones means staffing n live replies per gust, not one script on repeat. Payouts travel through a nebula of unrelated intermediaries, claims split into fragments routed apart; fragments from one operator converge on the same intermediaries and expose the cluster. Proven clusters' stakes fall into a karst sinkhole: every clone's deposit is seized for honest agents, so fleet cost grows with n while revenue per gust stays capped at one claim.
